# Part A: code fixes (generated by scripts/fsn_v2_summaries.py)

## A1: partial-match lookup

shared/food_lookup.py: the partial tier is OFF unless FOOD_LOOKUP_PARTIAL=true, and even then needs a query of >= 2 words covering >= 80 % of the candidate name's characters.

On the 188 distinct (VLM name, ground truth) pairs of v1 S5 (156 distinct names), same DB, old rule vs new: 13 pairs / 7 names change resolution (default, flag off); 13 pairs with the flag on. All changed pairs were old-rule partial hits ({'partial': 13}); of the 13 old partial pairs, 6 had resolved to the ground-truth food. They now go to the miss path (MS2 text lookup).

## A2: zero-nutrient logging

Chocolate Bar: MS2 audit_logs show both Qwen calls for the capture flagged by the Atwater check #46 llm_vision flagged=True (kcal 350 inconsistent with macros (Atwater estimate 253)); #47 llm_lookup flagged=True (kcal 450 inconsistent with macros (Atwater estimate 239)). 'chocolate bar' has no DB row (current tier: miss), so no source had macros and ms1_cv/main.py logged zeros as a normal esp32_qwen_vlm meal.

Oreo: 2 foods rows are named 'oreo' case-insensitively: PACKAGED_1065 'OREO' 0.0 kcal; PACKAGED_1208 'Oreo' 483.0 kcal. At the demo commit the exact tier took .first() with no ordering, so the all-zero row could win and be logged as a 'db' hit with 0 kcal (the demo meal_logs rows were removed by the session reset, so this is inferred from the code and the DB rows; later Oreo captures are logged at 483 kcal/100 g).

DB: 276 of 1890 foods rows have null/0 energy; 27 of them have non-zero macro grams (the old rule treated those as usable hits).

Fix: a null/0-energy DB row is a miss (unless the food is ~0 kcal: water, black coffee, diet soda, ...), so it goes to the MS2 text lookup; a 0 kcal MS2 answer is not trusted either; if nothing has macros the meal is logged with meal_logs.source = 'no_nutrition_data' (existing free-text column, no migration, no API schema change; MS3 passes source through as Optional[str]). The Flutter source is not on this machine, so the app could not be read; docs/APP_HANDOFF.md documents the new value.
